messages:
Rita - Alliances: Hi Redwood 1: Alliance team wants a short co-sell POC. Needs: US residency, SSO (SAML), pilot pricing for ~8k req/day, and a 1-page runbook. Can we do next Tue?
Maya R: Yes Tuesday works. Looping Samir (pricing) and Jordan (infra). We can provision a us-east tenant and offer temp API keys for initial integration.
Samir K: Back-of-envelope: 8k/day -> ~240k/mo. Hosted pilot estimate ~5k-9k/mo. Will send a small table with hosted vs reserved and a 6-week pro-rate option by EOD.
Jordan L: Infra note: two paths1hosted (fast) or dedicated (isolation + better p95). I can create tenant and SAML SP metadata. Example test curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEMP_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.us-east-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Evan G: Security: need to know if Alliance will send PII, retention requirements, and whether they need SOC2/ISO artifacts for procurement. I'll open a questionnaire.
Rita - Alliances: Procurement will want SOC2; no PII in pilot. We'll share IdP metadata by EOD.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.ai/sec-queue/ALLI-2026-05 assigned to Evan G. Deadline 2026-05-12.
Maya R: Action items: Samir->pricing + pro-rate; Jordan->tenant + temp creds + SAML metadata; Evan->questionnaire + doc links. I'll own the runbook and kickoff agenda.
Samir K: Sent pricing draft to Maya, will copy Rita after approval. Includes burst delta and SLA note.
Jordan L: Tenant created and invite sent. Runbook draft uploaded to partnerships folder. Temp API key posted to vault.
Evan G: Questionnaire started; requested SOC2 artifact link and subprocessor list.
Rita - Alliances: Thanks all 1 looking forward to Tue. I'll post IdP metadata in the folder shortly.
Maya R: Great. If any enterprise blockers show, flag here and we'll escalate to SE. :thumbsup:
